protocol.scope: Maintain supported rest on level rigid surfaces; no approach/sit transition or leaning claim
protocol.reward: 2 per qualifying second; effort arm subtracts E/(E+reference) per qualifying second; -5 once on physical failure
protocol.E: mean over ALL joints of (applied torque / existing peak effort limit)^2; not electrical energy
protocol.action: 23 joint-target increments capped 0.01 rad per 20ms; joint/effort limits retained; no timed nominal controller
protocol.reset: Full root/joint position and velocity plus held command; .5s ordinary-tick settling with zero reward during resets; warmup transitions separately counted
protocol.runtime: 324 sensor-only channels: three frames of q,qd,torque,gravity,gyro,previous command and observed local plane; same critic inputs
protocol.evaluation: 28 unique held-out starts:16 at training heights and12 at intermediate heights; plus same12 with +/-0.06m/s base-velocity impulse at5s;20s per trial; all four final models and fixed PD
protocol.success: no latched failure,>=95% qualifying rest ticks, final2s continuously qualifying; integer counters
limitations: Two training seeds; perturbation cases repeat the intermediate-height placements
Ideal simulated encoder/IMU/torque equivalents; depth is measured, no runtime simulator geometry
Finite rigid floor blocks permit measured friction; top z=0, materials .8/.6; no inclined or compliant surfaces
Highest initial posture has light seat support and substantial foot load; report load alongside effort

caution: 40 conditions per policy use28 unique captured states;12 states repeat with perturbations. Two training seeds are not broad statistical evidence. Effort comparisons are conditional on shared successes.
